assumptions.statement: Climate risk contributes 35% to the integrated screening score.
Water stress contributes 35% to the integrated screening score.
Crop health concern contributes 30% to the integrated screening score.
Healthy baseline crop-health concern is represented by 0.
Moderate crop-health concern is represented by 50.
High crop-health concern is represented by 75.
Crop-health scenario values are not probabilities of disease and do not establish disease prevalence.
Phase 13 PlantVillage observations are not time-aligned with NASA POWER climate observations.
